LightningComponentBundle.description: Big-number KPI bound to any semantic model measure, with an optional target, sentiment, accent colour and sparkline. Re-queries when dashboard filters change.

property.name: measureField
property.label: Measure
property.description: Measure to aggregate (choose the aggregation in the panel).

property.name: trendDimension
property.label: Trend dimension
property.description: Optional month/date dimension: draws a sparkline and a vs-prior-period delta.

property.name: accentColor
property.label: Accent colour
property.description: Hex colour for the tile's stripe and sparkline.

property.name: title
property.label: Title
property.description: Optional tile heading; defaults to the measure label.

property.name: target
property.label: Target
property.description: Optional numeric target to compare against.

property.name: sentiment
property.label: Sentiment
property.description: Whether a higher value is good or bad.
